info.title: What is the Women Game Jam?
info.description1:
Women Game Jam is a hackathon for video games and board games, where you can learn, create, and connect. 

It takes place simultaneously in several countries and promotes diversity and inclusion in game development.
info.description2: It takes place simultaneously in several countries and promotes diversity and inclusion in game development.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.firstQuestion: Do I need to know how to code to participate?
faq.firstAnswer: It is not necessary to know how to code. The Hackathon not only focuses on developing video games, you can also create board games. The main thing is to learn and share.
faq.secondQuestion: Do I need to have a team?
faq.secondAnswer: No, if you want you can register by yourself and on the first day of the event we will help you find a team.
